title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Coordination Claim Reference: Other-Coverage Denials
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — coordination claims for other-coverage denials (CO-22).** When a payer denies a claim because other coverage is primary, Halverson Clinical Laboratories refiles the claim with the patient's current coordination of benefits.

## When a coordination claim answers the denial

A coordination claim answers an other-coverage denial where the coverage's coordination order on file already gives it the payment position the coordination rules assign it and, where the payer class requires it, the patient has updated their other-coverage information with the payer. An other-coverage denial (CO-22) is cured by a coordination claim without a further coordination update where the coverage's coordination order on file already gives it that position.

A coordination correction answers the claim's most recent other-coverage denial and carries the denied amount being resubmitted, as fixed by the company's rule for coordination corrections.

## Capability

`file_coordination_correction_d59a8135` records one coordination-of-benefits resubmission, dated today, on the claim ledger of the coverage the claim was filed with, under the original claim number, linked to the other-coverage denial line it answers and carrying the amount put back in front of the plan. Nothing else on the coverage or the claim changes. On success the coordination claim appears in the coverage's claim history.

## Invocation

Agent-side: unlock `file_coordination_correction_d59a8135`, then call it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | The coverage the claim is refiled with, as returned by the coverage lookup | Id |
| `customer_id` | The patient's customer reference number, as returned by the customer lookup | Id |
| `claim_number` | Laboratory claim number of the claim being refiled | 'C' followed by 10 digits, exactly as shown on the claim history |
| `order_id` | The order the refiled claim bills, as shown on the claim history line | Id |
| `source_claim_event_id` | The other-coverage denial line the refiled claim answers, as returned by the claim-history lookup | Id |
| `rebill_amount` | Amount the refiled claim puts back in front of the plan | USD with 2 decimal places, non-negative, rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A text receipt: `claim_event_id` (reference number of the new resubmission), `event_type` `coverage_claim_resubmitted` and `resubmission_reason` `coordination_of_benefits_update` (confirming a coordination-of-benefits resubmission was recorded), `claim_number` (the claim refiled), `amount` (the amount put back, USD with 2 decimal places), `event_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `claim_event_id` means the refiled claim was recorded.
